— 200
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management successfully updated the specified OT connector.
— 400 Returned if the OT connector id or type is missing or invalid.
— 403 Returned if you do not have permission to update the OT connector.
— 404 Returned if the specified OT connector id doesn't exist.
500
Returned if Tenable Vulnerability Management encountered an error while attempting to update the OT
connector.
